correctness.rationale: Reassessed the narrowed result in repairs/2/RESULT.md. The weight-zero identity at (v,v), (1,1), and (1,v) gives radical-valued P(a+v)=au+T(v), T^2=0; bilinearity and characteristic two give the converse. Thus P^3=0 and P^2=0 exactly when T(u)=0, of conditional probability q^(−r) at rank r. Counting image–kernel flags and the induced quotient isomorphism gives B_(n,r)=q^(2r(n−r)) c_n/(c_r c_(n−2r)); every T has equally many markings, so the finite probability is the B-weighted average of q^(−r). Substitution r=m−j yields the displayed limiting weights. The finite product ratio is at most one and tends to one for fixed j; a positive infinite-product lower bound gives summable bounds on the weights and on q^j times the weights. Dominated convergence with positive denominator yields the sharp fixed-q equivalent, separately on both parities. An independent series evaluation through j=40 at 60-digit precision gave constants (1.41971069617869, 1.08804625771742) for q=2 and (1.24519786046859, 1.01264585799863) for q=4, in even/odd order. The q=2 truncation bound in the repair controls both series. The frozen script was inspected, not executed; the bounded series check is not a substitute for the limit proof. The frozen structural, orbit and count statements are mathematically correct; the repair is for claim scope, not a counterexample.
